text:
debrief db-021
1) the ac-tor u-sed m-e-ta-d-a-t-a e-x-f-i-l-t-r-a-t-i-o-n t-o r-e-a-c-h t-h-e p-a-s-s-w-o-r-d s-t-o-r-e-s and l-e-f-t a n-e-t-w-o-r-k c-a-p-t-u-r-e l-o-g wh-i-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n a-n-a-l-y-s-i-s.
2) t-h-e y o u s e d a c-l-o-n-e-d b-i-o-m-e-t-r-i-c t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s f-r-o-m t-h-e d-e-v-i-c-e d-u-m-p to e-n-r-o-l-l t-h-e f-a-l-s-e i-d and l-e-f-t a r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d wh-i-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-p-o-o-f-e-d t-h-e a-c-c-e-s-s c-o-n-t-r-o-l l-o-g-s b-y e-d-i-t-i-n-g t-i-m-e-s-t-a-m-p-s and l-e-f-t a t-a-i-l-l-e-d d-b-d-u-m-p wh-i-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k-s.
4) t-h-e y o u s e d a m-f-a-l-s-e b-a-d-g-e i-m-a-g-e c-o-p-i-e-d f-r-o-m t-h-e c-h-e-c-k i-n l-i-s-t to e-n-t-e-r t-h-e r-e-s-t-r-i-c-t-e-d a-r-e-a and l-e-f-t a c-c-t-a t-i-o-n a-l-a-r-m e-v-e-n-t wh-i-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-a-d-g-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) t-h-e y o u s e d a f-a-k-e i-d e-n-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n r-e-c-o-r-d t-o m-a-k-e l-o-g-s l-o-o-k l-e-g-i-t and l-e-f-t a d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e-d e-m-p l-o-y-e-e f-i-l-e wh-i-le s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l.
